selection.rationale: Selected the required primary model MLP Neural Network using validation f1 (0.6533); other families are comparison baselines. The test partition was not used to choose the model.
notes: The configured primary family is fixed by the product objective.
Its threshold is chosen using validation rows only.

error_analysis.interpretation: A false positive is a retained customer predicted to churn (wasted retention spend). A false negative is a churner predicted to stay (missed save opportunity). Recall drives missed churners; precision drives outreach cost.

logistic_regression.note: Aggregate counts and mean probabilities only; no customer identifiers or raw records are exposed.

preprocessing.strategy: refit per fold from the Phase 5 base frame

notes: CV metrics are a stability estimate at the 0.5 reference threshold; the held-out test result remains the primary evidence.
Each fold refits the Phase 5 column plan, imputers, scaler and encoder on its own training rows; validation rows are transform-only.
The base frame is reconstructed from the recorded raw artifact and accepted only if a full-training refit reproduces the Phase 5 matrices exactly; otherwise CV is reported as unavailable.

limitations: Metrics describe one held-out split; they are not a guarantee of future churn behaviour or causal retention impact.
A threshold selected to maximise validation F1 is a statistical choice, not automatically the best business decision; contact costs and capacity are modeled in later phases.
The benchmark compares model families on one dataset; results do not transfer automatically to other customer bases.
Test metrics were computed once. Re-running this benchmark on a new split produces a new evaluation, not a re-tuned score for this one.
Cross-validation was disabled for this run.
Probability calibration is summarised by the Brier score only; no recalibration was fitted.
